questions.question: If your brakes fail when going downhill, why should you decide what to do quickly?

options.text: The longer you wait, the faster your vehicle will go.
The longer you wait, the more vehicles will get out of your way.
The longer you wait, the slower your vehicle will go.

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer you wait, the faster your vehicle will go.
questions.explanation: Act quickly when your brakes fail on a downhill slope. The longer you wait, the faster your vehicle will be moving. This makes it much harder to stop.

questions.question: When drivers turn, which direction do they usually look?

options.text: Look in the direction of the turn.
Look in the direction opposite the turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look in the direction of the turn.
questions.explanation: Drivers usually look in the direction they are turning. If a driver does not signal, you can still watch their body movements for clues that they plan to turn.

questions.question: What should a driver do at bus stops?

options.text: Warn exiting passengers about potential hazards.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warn exiting passengers about potential hazards.
questions.explanation: At bus stops, warn passengers about hazards. For example, tell them to watch their step when exiting the bus using the lowered stairs.

questions.question: What is the only way to become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.correctAnswerText: Wait.
questions.explanation: Only time will make you sober. Your liver removes alcohol at a fixed rate. Cold showers and coffee do not speed up this process. You must wait for your body to eliminate the alcohol.

questions.question: During the driving test, how should you make a lane change?

options.text: You should not be concerned with other motorists.
You should use your turn signal and change lanes when safe.
You should make the lane change as quickly as possible, even if that means cutting off another driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should use your turn signal and change lanes when safe.
questions.explanation: During the driving test, check your mirrors, use your turn signal, and smoothly change lanes only when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: During the driving test, what should you do at a railroad crossing?

options.text: Pass another vehicle on the tracks if the other vehicle is going too slow.
Get out of the vehicle to check for a train.
Not change gears while your vehicle is on the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not change gears while your vehicle is on the tracks.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, do not stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes while any part of your vehicle is on the tracks.

questions.question: What happens to shaded areas of a road in winter?

options.text: Are usually blocked from all moisture, so they cannot freeze.
Will remain slick after ice has melted on other areas of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Will remain slick after ice has melted on other areas of the road.
questions.explanation: Shaded areas get less sunlight and warm up slowly. They will remain icy and slippery after ice has melted on other parts of the road.

questions.question: If there is a cargo fire in a box trailer, what should you do with the doors?

options.text: The trailer doors should be opened.
The trailer doors should not be opened.
A large, heavy blanket should be put over the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: The trailer doors should not be opened.
questions.explanation: Do not open trailer doors if there is a cargo fire. Opening the doors gives the fire more oxygen, which makes it grow larger.

questions.question: What tread depth should be in every major groove of a front tire?
questions.correctAnswerText: 4/32 of an inch
questions.explanation: Front tires must have a tread depth of 4/32 of an inch in every major groove for safe operation. Other tires must have a tread depth of 2/32 of an inch.

questions.question: When passing parked vehicles, what should a driver watch for?

options.text: Watch for signs of a person exiting a vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for signs of a person exiting a vehicle.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing parked vehicles. Someone may step out of a parked vehicle or from between cars without looking. A driver may also start moving their vehicle without seeing you.

questions.question: Can you use radial and bias-ply tires together?

options.text: Yes, on the front of the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, not together.
questions.explanation: Do not use radial and bias-ply tires together. All tires on a vehicle must be the same type and size.

questions.question: When does hydroplaning usually happen?

options.text: When tires have good air pressure.
Where water builds up on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Where water builds up on the road.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens where water collects on the road. It can happen at speeds as low as 30 mph. Under-inflated tires and worn tread make hydroplaning more likely.

questions.question: Why should you accelerate slowly on surfaces with poor traction?

options.text: Because slow acceleration is always best.
To keep control of the vehicle.
So you don't go faster than the car ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: To keep control of the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Accelerate slowly in poor traction conditions like rain or snow to avoid losing control.

questions.question: Which one is not a type of distraction?
questions.correctAnswerText: Obtuse
questions.explanation: Driving distractions are physical (like reaching for something), mental (like talking with a passenger), or both (like using a hand-held phone).

questions.question: You are driving slowly in a construction zone and see a worker near the road. What should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down more.
questions.explanation: Always slow down in construction areas. Slow down even more if there are workers on or near the road.

questions.question: When speeding up on a wet road, what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up slowly.
questions.explanation: Always accelerate gradually when driving on surfaces with poor traction.

questions.question: How can you check if the road is becoming icy?

options.text: Open your window and touch the side mirror for ice.

questions.correctAnswerText: Open your window and touch the side mirror for ice.
questions.explanation: If you think ice may be forming, open your window and feel the side mirror, mirror support, or antenna. If ice is on these items, the road is likely icing up too.

questions.question: Which one does not cause hydraulic brake failure?
questions.correctAnswerText: Downshifting
questions.explanation: Hydraulic brake failure usually happens for two reasons: loss of hydraulic pressure or brake fade from overheating on long hills.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a vehicle inspection report?

options.text: Tell the motor carrier about problems that need fixing
Make sure the vehicle is inspected regularly
Hold people responsible for inspecting the vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell the motor carrier about problems that need fixing
questions.explanation: A vehicle inspection report tells the carrier about any problems that need to be fixed.

questions.question: What should drivers talking to passengers be considered?
questions.correctAnswerText: Distracted drivers.
questions.explanation: Drivers talking to passengers may be distracted from driving. Be extra careful around distracted drivers.
